trailhead.label: Cervatto (1,002 m), the park authority’s start

cautions: The first stretch from Cervatto to Giavina is on the village road: lead on for passing cars.
Old stone mule track with steps and loose stones in places, slippery when wet.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
